title: Rugs
summary: Rugs is recorded as a Southampton Town place-name at Noyack, connected with a neck of land and creek. The stream is associated with Thompson's Trout Ponds.
address_label: General area of Trout Pond / Thompson's Trout Ponds, Noyack, Southampton Town
history_content: The name appears in a 1738 Southampton highway layout that referred to Rugs stream and Ruggs neck. The stream is identified with the brook known as Thompson's Trout Ponds at Noyack.
translation_content:
No secure landscape translation is given for Rugs. The name is described as that of an Indigenous person who lived there, and Rugg is also noted as an Indigenous personal name.

Why Place Names Matter

“Naming has been shown to be a tool for asserting authority, constructing national identity, conducting diplomacy, and embedding ideologies within the landscape.”

— John Wagner Givens, What’s in a Name? Toward the Study of Names in Political Science (2026), Article introduction
preservation_content: Rugs preserves a Native personal name within the geography of Noyack. Its survival in road and creek records points to Indigenous presence in places later described through Southampton town records.
